name: print-social-travp-holiday-posts-beige-with-arch-photos-and-retro-serif
title: 'travp' holiday pack in beige and terracotta with arch photos, organic blobs and retro serif
whatItIs: Five square posts in beige with terracotta and mustard blobs, arch and pill-cropped photos of masked travellers, heavy retro serif headlines ('May your occasions be cheerful and brilliant!') mixing maroon and mustard, a 'Live podcast' pill and leaf outlines.
whatItMeans: Warm and nostalgic; the soft serif and earthy tones feel gentle and hopeful.
techniques: Use a heavy retro serif in two warm colours.
Crop photos into arches and pills.
Add a vertical rule beside body text.

vocabulary.definition: A soft, heavy serif reminiscent of the 1970s.
